messages:
anjali: partner reported seeing DB connection strings in their ingest logs. they pasted a chunk and it includes what looks like a Vault token in an env dump. this seems time-sensitive. :rotating_light:
security-bot: alert: creds-exposure detector matched pattern VAULT_TOKEN in partner S3 logs. incident INC-5310 opened and assigned to #eng-security. automated scan found 3 objects.
gabe: can you drop the redacted snippet? need to see if token is long-lived or a wrapped token.
anjali: redacted sample: `VAULT_TOKEN=st.v1xxxxxxREDACTEDxxxxxx` (log time 2026-03-22T09:18:02Z). original objects saved to /secure/incidents/INC-5310/raw/. removed partner object access.
tom: ok immediate actions: 1) revoke the token, 2) list leases and revoke secrets leased by that token, 3) rotate any DB creds issued using leases tied to that token, 4) harden logging paths and remove env dumps.
lee: RBAC followup: the token belongs to service account `ingest-processor` which has policy `ingest-runner`. we should create a new minimal policy `ingest-runner-ephemeral` and require wrapped tokens with TTL <= 60s for all CI/workers. I'll push the policy change and an explicit deny for the old long-lived policy binding.
oncall: can do a brief window at 11:30 PT. canary first, then broad.
security-bot: INC-5310 updated: severity=high, status=investigating, assignees=[anjali, tom, lee], artifacts=/secure/incidents/INC-5310/.
gabe: commands to revoke and inspect leases (vault):
```bash
# revoke token immediately
vault token revoke st.v1xxxxxxREDACTEDxxxxxx
# find secret leases pinned to token
vault list -format=json sys/leases/lookup | jq '.[]'
# or check leases for the token
vault token lookup -format=json st.v1xxxxxxREDACTEDxxxxxx
# revoke leases discovered
vault lease revoke <lease-id>
```
anjali: note that our ingress lambda used VAULT_TOKEN from environment for faster startup. that's the anti-pattern here. we need to switch to response-wrapped tokens via Vault's wrap TTL in the short term.
lee: policy patch (HCL snippet):
```hcl
path "secret/data/ingest/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
  allowed_parameters = {
    "version" = ["1"]
  }
}
# new ephemeral policy
path "auth/token/create" {
  capabilities = ["update"]
}
```
compliance: please log retention note: keep audit artifacts for 2 years for this class B incident. tagging for legal hold.
tom: rewrap plan for any ciphertexts stored externally: partner used our wrapped payloads previously. after we rotate KMS key we need to rewrap partner ciphertexts. sample gcloud rewrap: `gcloud kms keys versions add-rotation-schedule ...` no, actually we can re-encrypt via: `echo $PLAINTEXT | gcloud kms encrypt --key=partner-ingest --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64` — but partner must accept new blob format. coordinating with partner now.
gabe: enable Vault audit before we do swaps, so we capture reads/writes:
```bash
vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-ingest.json
# forward to secure bucket
aws s3 cp /var/log/vault/audit-ingest.json s3://redwood-secure-audit/incidents/INC-5310/
```
anjali: I'm going to rotate the service DB creds that were issued recently by that token. steps: revoke token, create new DB user via our rotation job, write new creds to KV, signal partner to fetch wrapped token.
oncall: canary swap succeeded at 11:36 PT (health stable). ready for prod.
lee: changed RBAC binding: removed `ingest-processor` long-lived token privileges and bound `ingest-runner-ephemeral` role. enforced `token_policies` TTL <= 60s on CI roles. pushed policy PR and applied in staging.
compliance: received audit artifacts, marked retention in ticket. record: data exfil risk assessed as moderate due to short window; recommended 2-year retention and full timeline doc.
gabe: post-rotation checks: grep logs across last 7 days for `VAULT_TOKEN` and PG connection patterns, index results to incident doc. also run `vault token lookup` for any suspicious tokens created around the same timestamp.
anjali: completed rotation at 11:49 PT. revoked tokens, rotated DB creds, rewrapped partner blobs and uploaded new wrapped payload to partner endpoint. documenting steps in /secure/incidents/INC-5310/playbook.md.
security-bot: INC-5310 updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[anjali, tom, lee], artifacts=/secure/incidents/INC-5310/, severity=high.
anjali: follow-ups: 1) forbid env-injection of VAULT_TOKEN in lambdas (use response wrapping & short-lived), 2) scheduled automation to rotate any tokens older than 12h, 3) update onboarding docs for partner integrations to require server-side fetch of wrapped secrets. will create follow-up tasks.
tom: i'll open a vuln ticket to add static scanners to detect env var dumps in deploy pipelines. low false positives but worth it.
lee: also recommend enabling KMS HSM protection on partner key and setting automatic rewrap hook after key rotation. coordinate with infra for key rotation cadence.
anjali: thanks team. I'll run a post-sweep grep for 14 days and confirm no further exposures, then close the incident after compliance sign-off.
